export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec117/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && python3 -B -c '
import hashlib,json,os
g=json.load(open("eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json"))
print("goal_hash_ok",hashlib.sha256(g["original_goal"].encode()).hexdigest()==g["original_goal_hash"]=="30a1de05fc91233a51fb054852bc389252948f969d89393207f5ef5c382ce454")
print("preflight sha",hashlib.sha256(open("eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-preflight-report.json","rb").read()).hexdigest())
for p in [".git",".dev-graph",".dev-graph/config.json",".dev-graph/state/graph.json","eval-log","plugins/dev-graph"]:
  print(p,"islink",os.path.islink(p),os.path.realpath(p))
pf=json.load(open("eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-preflight-report.json"))
bad=[k for k,v in pf["inputs"].items() if hashlib.sha256(open(k,"rb").read()).hexdigest()!=v]
print("input digest mismatches",bad)
'; ls eval-log/ eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec 2>&1
